caption: The drawing features four abstract, floral-inspired designs spread across a plain, off-white background. In the upper left, there is a symmetrical motif composed of leaf-like brown shapes and stems with circles on top, flanking a central red form with a green and white checkered interior, all bordered by dark blue and brown. To the right, a large, irregular flower shape is depicted with brown outer petals, a blue inner layer, a red central section bordered in white with small green X-shaped marks, and a spiraling brown stem extending outward. In the lower left, a branching design with three main fronds includes a blue, scalloped-edged leaf, a solid brown leaf, and a tan leaf with a serrated edge, along with a diminutive brown detail at the base. Below and to the right of this, a reddish flower with brown jagged petals has an asymmetrical cream and blue center, while a small blue, star-like flower is to the immediate right. Handwritten pencil text can be seen to the right of the large flower. The primary colors in the artwork are red, brown, blue, tan, green, cream, and white, all arranged on a plain background with no framing.
title: Colcha
